category_title: Students who are hesitant or fearful of physical challenges
minimal_context: The student is standing on the high platform preparing to jump off for the zip line.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Alright, it is your turn to jump off the platform for the zip line.

STUDENT: I'm not gonna do that. I am sort of afraid of heights.

TUTOR: Just step closer to the edge and get ready.

STUDENT: I am really scared of falling. I don't know if I can do this.

TUTOR: The equipment is set up. You just need to jump.

STUDENT: (Stands frozen on the platform) I know I need to trust the belayers and trust the equipment, but I'm too scared of falling to take the extra step right now.

options.A: Ask the student to complete the sentence, 'When I zip off this platform, behaviors I am going to leave behind are . . .'
options.B: Permanently and thoroughly keep an eye on the student's physical safety, setting the safety equipment back into place as soon as it is moved the slightest.
options.C: Seldom intervene repressively, ensuring most interventions aim at reminding the student what they have to do on the platform or helping them do it.
options.D: Read the student's signals and lead the interaction according to what the student's capabilities are at that moment on the zip line platform.
